elements.requirement: Subsections (2) to (5) apply where proceedings for the enforcement of a term of a contract are brought by a third party in reliance on section 1.
elements.quote: Subsections (2) to (5) apply where, in reliance on section 1, proceedings for the enforcement of a term of a contract are brought by a third party.

elements.requirement: The promisor has available to him by way of defence or set-off any matter that arises from or in connection with the contract, is relevant to the term, and would have been available to him by way of defence or set-off if the proceedings had been brought by the promisee.
elements.quote: The promisor shall have available to him by way of defence or set-off any matter that— (a) arises from or in connection with the contract and is relevant to the term, and (b) would have been available to him by way of defence or set-off if the proceedings had been brought by the promisee.

elements.requirement: The promisor has available to him by way of defence or set-off any matter if an express term of the contract provides for it to be available to him in proceedings brought by the third party, and that matter would have been available to him by way of defence or set-off had the promisee brought the proceedings.
elements.quote: The promisor shall also have available to him by way of defence or set-off any matter if— (a) an express term of the contract provides for it to be available to him in proceedings brought by the third party, and (b) it would have been available to him by way of defence or set-off if the proceedings had been brought by the promisee.

elements.requirement: The promisor has available to him by way of defence or set-off any matter that would have been available to him against the third party if the third party had been a party to the contract.
elements.quote: by way of defence or set-off any matter, and (b) by way of counterclaim any matter not arising from the contract, that would have been available to him by way of defence or set-off or, as the case may be, by way of counterclaim against the third party if the third party had been a party to the contract.

elements.requirement: The promisor has available to him by way of counterclaim any matter not arising from the contract that would have been available to him against the third party if the third party had been a party to the contract.
elements.quote: by way of counterclaim any matter not arising from the contract, that would have been available to him by way of defence or set-off or, as the case may be, by way of counterclaim against the third party if the third party had been a party to the contract.

elements.requirement: The defences, set-offs, and counterclaims available under subsections (2) and (4) are subject to any express term of the contract specifying matters that are not to be available to the promisor.
elements.quote: Subsections (2) and (4) are subject to any express term of the contract as to the matters that are not to be available to the promisor by way of defence, set-off or counterclaim.

elements.requirement: A third party who seeks in reliance on section 1 to enforce a term of a contract in proceedings brought against him (including a term purporting to exclude or limit liability) may not do so if he could not have done so—whether due to particular circumstances relating to him or otherwise—had he been a party to the contract.
elements.quote: Where in any proceedings brought against him a third party seeks in reliance on section 1 to enforce a term of a contract (including, in particular, a term purporting to exclude or limit liability), he may not do so if he could not have done so (whether by reason of any particular circumstances relating to him or otherwise) had he been a party to the contract.
